response.sql: SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM (SELECT SupportRepId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer GROUP BY SupportRepId) AS t

assumptions.assumption: Customers with NULL SupportRepId form one group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together), and that group counts as one value in the average, as the request states.
The average is computed as a non-integer (multiplying by 1.0 avoids integer division) and left unrounded.
